continuity_scope: Pillars of Eternity: Definitive Edition, English PC/Mac/Linux release boundary (15 November 2017). It contains the 2015 original game, The White March Parts I and II, premium content, and the Deadfire Pack. This pass is not Pillars of Eternity II: Deadfire, does not apply 2026 patches, and does not infer a fixed Watcher/avatar identity.

Obsidian: Pillars of Eternity game page

coverage_rule: Zero-character evidence-constrained pass. The selected official sources document the game/edition, original campaign and expansion package, player-created main character, optional companion system, races, classes, souls, and custom rules. They do not provide a reproducible named individual companion/NPC roster with individual official character profiles or direct dialogue/journal/codex locators. The Watcher is not a node: the first-game selected witness frames the main character as player-authored. No fan or community source is used to manufacture a cast.
omissions: The player-created main character/Watcher, all player-selected race, class, background, build, choices, party composition, dialogue, and endings.
All named companions, NPCs, antagonists, rulers, gods, and other dramatic individuals because no selected first-party witness supplies individual claim-level profiles or direct game-text locators.
Classes, races, factions, souls, gods, companion system, items, locations, spells, mechanics, and rules as character nodes.

Pillars of Eternity II: Deadfire, current 2026 patches, the original-only release as a separate patch state, editions/platform variants outside the named Definitive Edition, and all non-game, fan, community, wiki, walkthrough, novel, or adaptation material.
uncertainties: The full game includes named companions and scripted dialogue, but no direct individual in-game dialogue/journal/codex material was accessible in the selected first-party evidence. The audit remains terms-only rather than using secondary sources.

The 2012 Project Eternity overview is pre-release design material. It is used only for high-level optional-party, race/class, soul, and custom-system terminology, not to establish a final named cast or an unqualified release behavior.
Companions are expressly optional and player paths shape outcomes. No universal party, relationship, recruitment, or ending is asserted.
Definitive Edition bundles The White March and Deadfire Pack; this pass records package scope only and does not import their story content. Localization variants and later fixes remain separate.
No plot-resolution claims are made, avoiding unmarked spoilers.
evidence_basis: First-party Obsidian/official publisher game, edition-announcement, and development overview pages. No fan wiki, Wikipedia, community forum, walkthrough, review, or secondary character directory is used as canonical evidence.

supports: Definitive Edition release date, included original game/White March/premium content/Deadfire Pack, and edition boundary
